chunks: So he prayed to his Lord: "I am helpless, deliver me."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication 'I am helpless, deliver me' in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as a paradigm of *istighatha* (seeking help) during times of distress, with many scholars identifying the supplicant as Prophet Yusha' bin Nun or, more commonly, Prophet Musa (AS) during the Battle of Badr or the parting of the sea. It underscores the theological principle that divine victory is granted not merely through military strength but through sincere reliance on Allah (*tawakkul*) and direct invocation, a concept deeply embedded in Shia devotional practices such as *Dua Kumayl* and *Dua Tawassul*.
